description: This Java utility class provides static methods for handling field expressions within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes functions to check, add, or remove prefixes for attribute and definition fields, and to create regex patterns for field existence checks. It also contains an inner class FeatureField to parse and represent feature-specific field names.

classes.name: FieldExpressionUtil
classes.description: Utility class for field expressions with methods to process field names and an inner class to parse feature fields.

classes.name: FieldExpressionUtil.FeatureField
classes.description: Represents a feature field which includes optional featureId and property, and provides logic to parse field name strings following specific patterns.

methods.name: wrapExistsRegex
methods.description: Wraps the given field in a regex pattern that matches from start and ends with either a slash or end of string.

methods.name: parseFeatureField
methods.description: Parses a field name to determine if it is a feature field and returns an Optional containing a FeatureField object if it is.

methods.name: isAttributeFieldName
methods.description: Checks whether the given field name starts with 'attributes/' indicating an attribute field.

methods.name: stripAttributesPrefix
methods.description: Removes the 'attributes/' prefix from the given field name.

methods.name: isDefinitionFieldName
methods.description: Checks whether the given field name starts with 'definition/' indicating a definition field.

methods.name: addAttributesPrefix
methods.description: Adds the 'attributes/' prefix to the given field name.
